text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, before the Challenge Cup, 
there's a race I absolutely have to run."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It's payback time! I've gotta pay them 
back for beating me to that overseas 
expedition!

I naturally knew which race Tap Dance City 
wanted, and the rival she sought to settle 
scores with.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—!? So she's running here, huh? No, 
wait...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So that's where they're gonna "bring it 
out." I see.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Sure, there's nothin' for me to gain by 
teaming up with *you*. But still..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
As an enemy, that's a different story! 
Come at me—you kindred spirit!

—The Kikuka Sho. The greatest rival is the 
data-driven Umamusume, Air Shakur.

Since that is the case, we have no choice 
but to use logic and make a gamble of our 
own.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer. What is our strategy this 
time?

The keyword she arrived at after careful, 
meticulous thought. That was—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: What? 6, not 4...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, I have even less of a clue than 
usual! Tell me more, give me the details.

I will explain thoroughly. Regarding the 
strategy that can only be employed because 
this is the Kikuka Sho.

For this strategy to succeed, Tap Dance 
City's course positioning is more 
important than anything.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I see. So you're telling me to run 
strictly along that designated route.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Interesting, let me show you how it's 
done! I'll show you some steering that'll 
make your jaw drop.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Shakur. Did you enjoy your naval 
battle with the British Royal Navy?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna show ya a real good time today. 
I brought a crazy huge souvenir with me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —I bet.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Huh? How did you know?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A 3,000-meter long-distance race. In a 
race at this distance where strategy 
matters most—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's no way they'd let you charge in 
empty-handed.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I get it, you know. Better than you do, 
when it comes to your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, I can't just let that slide. 
They belong to me, got it?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"If you really wanna act like my buddy 
that badly, then you'd better beat me 
first!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Don't need it. But—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm gonna teach you who really 
rules this game.

The one running is Tap Dance City. 
However, while this is a race between 
Umamusume, it is also—

It was a battle of logic between Air 
Shakur and me. Beneath the turf, a war of 
wits sent sparks flying.
